title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Call-In Interval for a Borrower in Care
content:
The **call-in interval** by which scheduled contacts of an in-care borrower are counted on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile rests on two records:

- **Long stay:** the borrower's admission date — the date stated on the primary borrower's accepted health-care absence notice received most recently — lies 6 or more whole calendar months before the handling date;
- **Payments:** the monitored Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan disbursed three or more scheduled monthly payments dated on or before the handling date and less than three whole calendar months before it, as its transaction history shows.

| Long stay | Payments | Call-in interval |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 28 calendar days |
| yes | no | 60 calendar days |
| no | yes | 60 calendar days |
| no | no | the plan's interval between contacts during a health-care absence — 90 calendar days under every plan |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month. A profile monitoring no HECM loan has no such payments.
